title: Kicked Crunchy Turkish Wild Garlic Leaves Skewers
description: A salty and crunchy Turkish dish featuring wild garlic leaves, this recipe is a nostalgic treat that is also sugar-free-friendly, served in scallop shells for a unique presentation.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the wild garlic leaves and pat them dry with a paper towel.
In a large bowl, mix together olive oil, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Add the wild garlic leaves to the bowl and toss to coat with the oil mixture.
Cut the papillote paper into 10 equal pieces and wrap each piece around a few garlic leaves, securing with a toothpick.
Place the wrapped garlic leaves on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the tops with lemon juice and bake for 12 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve the crunchy garlic leaves in scallop shells.
